title: Chip Veteran Raises Malaysia E&E Export Forecast to $223 Billion
description: Malaysia’s chip industry chief raised his forecast for the nation’s electrical and electronics exports this year to more than 900 billion ringgit ($223 billion), as demand fueled by the global artificial-intelligence boom surpassed earlier expectations.

title: Lightspeed Sees Globally Competitive Indian AI Model by 2027
description: A globally competitive homegrown Indian AI model is set to be released by next year, according to venture capital firm Lightspeed.

title: Yotta Plans IPO ‘Soon’ to Meet Demand, Chairman Says
description: Data center operator Yotta Data Services Pvt is in talks to tap capital markets “very soon” to meet surging demand for AI services, according to its chairman.
